ModuleTitle.helper: Administrator-facing title for this module. This syncs with DNN module settings and is not displayed to visitors.

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Used for page anchor links. Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the card grid. HTML is allowed.
SectionHeading.placeholder: The right result should feel easy to find.

HeadingCss.helper: Optional. CSS classes for styling the section heading.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short introduction shown below the heading. HTML is allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Experience a seamless journey from intent to connection.

Cards.helper: Add image-top cards in display order. Every card requires an image; icon and alternate visual modes are intentionally not available.

Title.helper: Required. Card title. HTML is allowed.

TitleCss.helper: Optional. CSS classes for styling the card title.

Description.helper: Required. Short supporting description. HTML is allowed.
Description.placeholder: Type a need, see immediate, relevant suggestions.

Eyebrow.helper: Optional. Short uppercase label displayed above the card title.

EyebrowColorClass.helper: Choose a Bootstrap or portal.css text utility. Teal is the default. Use a light color on dark card backgrounds and a dark color on light card backgrounds for accessible contrast.

CardImage.helper: Required. Uploads go to Content/. Use a landscape image at least 1200 by 675 pixels. The image renders in a fixed 12rem-high, full-width crop.

CardImageAlt.helper: Optional but strongly recommended for meaningful images. Describe the image for people using assistive technology; leave blank only when decorative.
CardImageAlt.placeholder: Search interface surrounded by profile results

Link.helper: Optional. If a link is added, the entire card becomes clickable.
